posters.name: sable
posters.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished portrait 1:2 advertising poster texture for a huge skyscraper screen in a dystopian futuristic racing game. Brand SABLE, cybernetic enhancements. Ultra-premium photoreal advertising: close-up of an androgynous adult model's face and neck merging with beautifully engineered black ceramic and titanium neural implants, clinical porcelain skin, fine implanted optic details, cool ice-white key light and sharp cobalt reflections. Model occupies upper two-thirds; deep black background, strong monumental composition, cold aspirational luxury with quietly sinister corporate control. Contemporary speculative editorial typography, massive bold clean sans serif, surgical precision. Include ONLY the exact large text 'SABLE' at top, 'HUMAN, UPGRADED.' across lower quarter, small 'NEURAL SYSTEMS' beneath. Small product diagram details acceptable, no other small copy. Full-bleed flat poster, absolutely no surrounding building or mockup, no glowing neon outlines, no retro synthwave, no vaporwave, no 1980s sign shapes, no pink-cyan tube lettering. Powerful full-color image, razor-sharp modern graphic design. White black cobalt restrained palette. Deliver one complete image.
